name: IEEE Registration Authority (OUI/MA-L, MA-M, MA-S, IAB and CID public listings)
tier_rationale: The IEEE Registration Authority assigns the MAC address blocks themselves (A8 trusted: internet registries and standards bodies with published terms); P315 council: provider tier trusted for the IEEE registry path.

reliability.justification: Authoritative registry of MAC address block assignments; the public CSV listings are regenerated daily by the IEEE RA.

oui_registries.title: IEEE RA public registry listings oui.csv, mam.csv, oui36.csv, iab.csv and cid.csv (whole files through the dataset manager; matched offline)

terms.quote: Offline module (disclosure 'none', runs at TLP:RED): IEEE MA-L, MA-M, MA-S (and CID) CSVs from standards-oui.ieee.org through the dataset manager (monthly; sent with the V3LUM UA because IEEE may block generic library UAs) [P315 cond 1; research C0708 terms 'IEEE public registry']

oui_registries.notes: Datasets ieee_oui_ma_l (oui/oui.csv, ~3.9 MB), ieee_oui_ma_m (oui28/mam.csv), ieee_oui_ma_s (oui36/oui36.csv), ieee_oui_iab (iab/iab.csv: IAB blocks are not repeated in oui36.csv) and ieee_oui_cid (cid/cid.csv); each < 5 MB, 5.7 MB together, monthly TTL. Live 2026-11-26: all 200 application/octet-stream with the V3LUM UA, Last-Modified = the same day (the files are regenerated daily), ETag '<mtime>-<size>', no rate-limit headers. Only whole files are downloaded: no MAC address or prefix is ever sent to the IEEE. Used by mac_oui (and read locally by mac_oui_online to decide that a prefix is missing).
